status_values.cited: stated in the method paper, docs or code at the given line
status_values.inferred_from_code: follows from the cited code, not stated in words
status_values.约定: 约定，未经推演: not found in the method sources; basis given

canonical_frame: project motion.npz: right-handed Z-up, metres; native Y-up maps (x, y, z) -> (x, -z, y) (utils/motiogen/motion.py:17-18,55-61, applied in utils/motiogen/adapters.py:80-81)
paths: baselines/... are relative to the data root (config/baselines.json data_root); other paths are repository paths

up_axis.basis: baselines/DART/README.md:235 "Please ensure the 3D scene is z-up and the floor plane has zero height"

forward_axis.basis: baselines/DART/utils/smpl_utils.py:54-62: x = right_hip - left_hip (SMPL-X joints 2 - 1) with z zeroed, z up, y = z cross x, so the canonical body faces +Y

units.basis: no unit statement in DART; SMPL-X body model in metres; reward slack 0.03 on foot z (env_reach_location_mld.py:365-374) consistent with metres

floor.definition: z = 0; at reset the lowest of the 22 joints of the first frame is put on the floor; the policy reward keeps the feet within 0.03 m of floor_height 0
